lines.zh: 我踩着草地跑，姿势学得很像
lines.en: I run on the grass, copying the pose well.

lines.zh: 我每一步都算好了落点
lines.en: I plan every footfall.

lines.zh: 我从树后闪出来，又躲回去
lines.en: I flash out from behind a tree and back.
I run faster than you would guess.
Grass clippings stick to my soles.

lines.zh: 我绕着你跑，保持一段距离
lines.en: I circle you, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 我一边跑一边回头看你
lines.en: I look back at you as I run.

lines.zh: 我故意跑得不稳，好让人以为是真的
lines.en: I run a little sloppily, to seem real.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟在我旁边，慢半拍
lines.en: My shadow lags half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 我踩着石头一路跑过去
lines.en: I run across the stones.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方草被压倒
lines.en: The grass goes down where I pass.
I put my head out from behind the bush.

lines.zh: 我站着，摆出那个熟悉的姿势
lines.en: I stand in that familiar pose.

lines.zh: 我的手指不自觉地弯着
lines.en: My fingers curl without my bidding.
I tilt my head and smile just right.
I am learning how he breathes.
There is no one else in the woods.

lines.zh: 我的鞋尖在地上来回蹭
lines.en: My toe scuffs back and forth.
I look at my own shadow.
I turn my wrist slowly.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹得有点乱
lines.en: Wind ruffles my fur a little.
I tuck my hands at my sides.

lines.zh: 我把一只鞋在草上蹭干净
lines.en: I wipe one shoe clean on the grass.
I watch how the leaves move.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很稳，像是练过
lines.en: My breathing is steady, as if rehearsed.

lines.zh: 我歪头听你踩草的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to you crush the grass.
I smile before I speak.
You recognize me; that makes it easier.
My voice is the same as his.

lines.zh: 你走过来一点，让我看清
lines.en: Come closer so I can see you.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，像要打招呼
lines.en: I raise a hand as if to greet you.
There is a trace of doubt in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你就退了一步
lines.en: I take one step; you take one back.

lines.zh: 我把头偏了偏，学他的样子
lines.en: I tilt my head the way he does.
You call my name, and I answer.
My smile widens.
I am in no hurry to move first.
You are staring at my eyes.
My fingers move behind my back.
Do not be afraid; I am here to help.
The tree behind you is moving.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，像等了很久
lines.en: I have stood here as if for a long time.
Let go of what you are holding.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，鞋底很轻
lines.en: I shift half a step, my sole light.
You had better believe what I say.

lines.zh: 我抬手把额前的毛拂开
lines.en: I brush the fur from my brow.
I step back, the smile unchanged.
My fingers curl.

lines.zh: 我按住被打的地方，很快放下
lines.en: I cover the wound, then drop my hand.
I tilt my head as if listening.
I crouch and rise again.
I cover the tear in my middle.
I back behind a tree for one breath.

lines.zh: 我的笑终于有点挂不住
lines.en: My smile finally slips a little.
I clench my fingers.

lines.zh: 我低头，毛里露出不是毛的东西。
lines.en: I look down, and something not fur shows through.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，给我看看
lines.en: Let me see what you have.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想让你松手
lines.en: I am not hungry; I just want your hands free.

lines.zh: 你伸手的时候，我就能动了
lines.en: When you reach out, I can move.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我看不清
lines.en: Hold it up; I cannot see.
I lean in a little; it is fine.
That hand of yours — keep it away.
I reach out, palm up.

lines.zh: 你往前一步，我就到手了
lines.en: One step from you and it is mine.
My smile grows more natural.

lines.zh: 这东西我不在乎，我在乎你放不放松
lines.en: I do not care about it; I care that you relax.
We collide and I plant my feet at once.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，姿势很漂亮
lines.en: I turn aside, elegantly.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上，退了一步
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and step back.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶你，力气大了些
lines.en: I catch you, a little too firmly.
We burst a patch of grass apart.
One roll of my shoulder sheds the blow.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我顺手扶了一下
lines.en: You charge and I steady you in passing.
The grass we part closes again.

lines.zh: 我退半步，动作像他一样
lines.en: I give half a step, moving just like him.

lines.zh: 我的鞋底在土上滑了一下
lines.en: My sole slips a little on the dirt.
Another one is pretending too.

lines.zh: 我们对着站，谁也不先破
lines.en: We face each other, neither breaking first.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是照着那只刺猬捏的。
lines.en: This face was modeled on that hedgehog.

lines.zh: 我们一同把脸转向前方
lines.en: We turn our faces forward as one.

lines.zh: 两只假刺猬在树后并排站。
lines.en: Two false hedgehogs stand side by side behind the tree.

lines.zh: 它站在我旁边，学我的站姿
lines.en: It stands beside me, copying my stance.

lines.zh: 我们两个笑得一模一样
lines.en: Our smiles are exactly alike.
Its hands are behind its back too.
We turn our heads at the same moment.
We do not need to plan.

lines.zh: 我弯腰去捡，动作很像他
lines.en: I bend to pick it up, just like him.

lines.zh: 我把它捏在手里，捏得有点紧
lines.en: I hold it, a little too tightly.

lines.zh: 我把那东西在指间转了一圈。
lines.en: I turn the thing once between my fingers.
I put it behind my back.
You are watching my hands.

lines.zh: 我把它捡起来，动作很顺
lines.en: I pick it up in one smooth motion.

lines.zh: 我低头的时候还在看你
lines.en: I watch you even as I bend.

lines.zh: 我把它在指间转了一下
lines.en: I turn it between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把它递过去，又收回来
lines.en: I offer it, then pull it back.
You reach, and I smile.
I stop, the smile still there.
I square my body to you.
I stop pretending now.
My fingers spread.

lines.zh: 你退的那一下，我都看见了
lines.en: I saw that flinch of yours.
My smile drops, and my shadow moves first.
The tip of my shoe already points at you.
My smile tightens a little.
I bend my knees, ready to launch.

lines.zh: 我不再看你的手，我看你的喉咙
lines.en: I stop watching your hands and watch your throat.
My movements quicken.
You have backed to a tree.
I raise a hand, slowly.
Your breathing's uneven. I can tell.
There is no one else in this wood.
I need not pretend any longer.
I follow you, neither fast nor slow.
You look back and I smile.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后侧，半步不差。
lines.en: I trail at your rear flank, not half a step off.
You walk faster; I do not hurry.

lines.zh: 我从树后绕到你的右边。
lines.en: I slip from behind the tree to your right.

lines.zh: 我的脚步踩在落叶上也无声。
lines.en: My steps fall silent even on dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，脚步落得很准
lines.en: I follow you, footfalls precise.
If you run, I need not smile.
I cut in from your left.
You go round a tree; I take the short way.
A fake Sonic sits at the corner of your eye.
You should not have gone deeper into the wood.
I count the steps you have taken.

lines.zh: 你回头，我在你后面三步
lines.en: You look back; I am three steps behind.

lines.zh: 你背对阳光，我的影子到你脚。
lines.en: You face away from the sun, and my shadow reaches your feet.
I do not shout; it would startle you.
You change direction; so do I.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离一直不变
lines.en: The gap between us never changes.
I am waiting for you to tire.
There is no fork in this wood.

lines.zh: 我一伸手就抓住你的肩
lines.en: One reach and I have your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的动作很快，没有多余
lines.en: I move fast, with nothing wasted.
One push and you slide several steps.
I raise a hand, the smile still on my face.
I reach and take your collar.
I close in a step, silent and quick.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的手腕
lines.en: My fingers lock your wrist.
One push and you hit a tree.
I sweep a foot at your knee.
I strike and step back, still smiling.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的手，我换另一只
lines.en: You stop one hand; I use the other.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下，压在你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from the tree and land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的手指刮到你的衣
lines.en: You pull away; my fingers rake your coat.

lines.zh: 我抓空了一次，立刻补上
lines.en: I miss once and follow at once.
I twist your hand back.
I drop my head into your chest.
I appear in the tree shadows first.
I stand as if I have just finished running.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，向你挥了一下
lines.en: I raise a hand and wave.
You saw me and relaxed.
I come closer, steps light.
My smile is just right.

lines.zh: 我先站在那儿，一动不动
lines.en: I stand there first, motionless.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，笑了一下
lines.en: I lift my head and smile.

lines.zh: 我抬脚走过来，步子和人一样
lines.en: I walk over with a person's gait.
The tree shadow slides over me.
I step into the light.
I raise a hand in greeting.
There is no mud on my soles.
I copy him well, don't I?
I tilt my head at you, friendly.

lines.zh: 林子里的鸟忽然不叫了
lines.en: The birds in the wood suddenly stop.
I slowly spread my fingers.
I look at you, then behind you.
I stamp one foot on the ground.

lines.zh: 我朝你走来的路上没有声音
lines.en: My approach made no sound.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我退得很远
lines.en: Fire catches my fur and I retreat far.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，落地很轻
lines.en: I fall from height and land lightly.

lines.zh: 水没过我，我沉下去不出声
lines.en: Water covers me and I sink silently.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，我马上起来
lines.en: The blast flips me and I rise at once.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进来，我低头看
lines.en: Something sticks in me; I look down.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的手压住
lines.en: That force pins my hands.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃东西，可我还笑着
lines.en: I have not eaten in long, and I am still smiling.

lines.zh: 雷光把林子照亮，我退到树后
lines.en: Lightning lights the wood; I retreat behind a tree.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我一路落下去
lines.en: No ground below; I fall.
